title: Secure Microservices with Network Policies
description: Create NetworkPolicies to restrict traffic between frontend and backend Pods.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
In a namespace `micro`, deploy a frontend and a backend Pod, then apply NetworkPolicies so that only the frontend can talk to the backend.

### Prerequisites
- A CNI that supports NetworkPolicy (Calico, Cilium, etc.). Minikube with `--cni=calico` or kind with Calico.

### Steps
1. Create namespace `micro`: `kubectl create ns micro`.
2. Deploy backend: a Pod with label `app: backend`, running `hashicorp/http-echo -text="Backend" -listen=:8080`. Expose via ClusterIP Service `backend-svc` on port 80.
3. Deploy frontend: a Pod with label `app: frontend`, using `alpine/curl` image (so you can curl). (It will sleep; use `command: ["sleep", "3600"]`).
4. Before applying any policy, exec into the frontend Pod and verify you can curl the backend: `curl backend-svc`. You should see "Backend".
5. Apply a NetworkPolicy that denies all ingress to Pods with label `app: backend` (podSelector: {app: backend}, policyTypes: Ingress, ingress: []).
6. Test again from frontend – curl should now fail (timeout).
7. Now create a second NetworkPolicy that allows ingress to backend Pods from Pods with label `app: frontend` on port 80.
8. Test again from frontend – curl should succeed.
9. (Optional) Try from a different Pod (e.g., a debug Pod with label `app: attacker`) – it should be blocked.
10. Clean up the namespace.
hints: The `deny-all` policy uses `podSelector: {}` to select all Pods, but for this task, target only backend Pods.
Multiple NetworkPolicies are additive; the deny policy can be overridden by an allow policy that also matches.
Use `kubectl exec -it <pod> -n micro -- sh` to test.
expectedOutput: Frontend can reach backend only after the allow policy is in place.
solutionCode:
# deny-backend-ingress.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-backend-ingress
  namespace: micro
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress: []
---
# allow-frontend-to-backend.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-frontend
  namespace: micro
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: frontend
    ports:
    - port: 80
      protocol: TCP
